items.description: The uri of an asset to include in the downloaded zip file.

folder_uri.description: The uri of folder to download as a zip file.

make_ticket.description: If true, generate a download ticket valid for 1 minute and include it in the uri.  Defaults to false.  Set true only for URLs that will be used from a web browser in cases that do not support setting an Authorization header. In all other circumstances, set false and use standard authorization.

time_zone_offset_minutes.description: Time zone offset, in minutes, of the client's local time from GMT (e.g. for EDT, tzo=240). If this parameter is not specified the file modification dates in the zip file will be in GMT, this parameter allows the client to get a zip file with client local time mod times.

zip_file_name.default: documents.zip or the name of the folder for folders
zip_file_name.description: The name to give the downloaded zip file.  If not provided, the default is documents.zip for assets, or the name of the folder for folders.
